approach: I traced the shipped route order from main.dart (_firstRunStack, frontDoor) through every builder in lib/routing/app_router.dart (C01 to O05, then T01, R03, E01, K01 to K07), with the flags in lib/domain/flags/feature_flags.dart deciding which branches are live. I quoted the on-screen copy from lib/l10n/app_en.arb. I judged each screen by one question: does it sell "a safe women-only room, and a week built for your body"? Then I listed the parts that already sell it, so fixes keep them.
trainee_path:
Shipped flags: accountRequired=true (feature_flags.dart:188), coachApp=false (:210), community=false (:205). The whole product sits behind verification (app_router.dart:565 openBeforeVerification = signup, onboarding, account, admin). First launch opens on C01 because frontDoorFor returns C01 for a signed-out woman (app_router.dart:4658). The setup questions are NOT stacked at launch, because isDue needs isVerified when an account is required (onboarding_state.dart isDue; main.dart:339).
1. C01 Welcome (app_router.dart:901). Headline "A room full of women training like you". Tap "Get started" [1].
2. C02 Language (:910). The device language is preselected (language_view.dart:54). Tap "Continue" [2], or 3 taps if she switches language.
3. C03 What's inside (:917). Four value cards: quiet home workouts, food you already cook, women only, coaches only with the flag. Tap "Create my account" [3]. Side branch: "Look around first" opens C04. It shows two placeholder workouts, and tapping one only raises "Save this workout?" (look_around_view.dart:84-109). The Recipes tab changes nothing.
4. C06 Phone (:936). The title reads "Step 1 of 2". She types her number and taps "Send me a code" [4].
5. C07 Code (:941). Titled "Step 2 of 2". The six digits check themselves with no tap. If she is already verified she goes to T01 or O01.
6. C08 Role (:991). "Which one are you?" With the coach app off there is only one option, preselected. Tap "Continue" [5].
7. C09 Why we check (:1012). "One check, then you are in … It takes about 90 seconds." Tap "Scan my ID" [6]. Niqab branch: C15 woman reviewer.
8. C09b Consent (:1031). Tap "I agree, start the camera" [7]. "I would rather not" goes to C15.
9. C10 ID front (:1056). Auto-capture, with a fallback "Take it myself" (+1).
10. C10b ID back (:1072). Auto-capture. Starting liveness can fail and branch to C15, C12 (limit or offline) or C14.
11. C11 Selfie (:1132). Tap "Done" [8].
12. C12 Checking (:1145). Waits "Usually seconds". When verified it moves on to C13 by itself. Retry goes to C10. A reviewer case goes to C14, the waiting room. A refusal goes to C14. Offline gives "We could not reach Own Hub" with Try again.
13. C13 You're in (:1197). Primary button "Read the three rules" [9].
14. C16 Pledge (:1269). Tap "I agree, let me in" [10].
15. O01 Goal (:1296). "Four short questions, then your week is ready." Continue [11].
16. O02 Place (:1308). Continue [12].
17. O03 Schedule (:1315). Continue [13].
18. O04 Life stage (:1322). Continue [14].
19. O05 Starting program (:1335). "Built from your four answers". Tap "Start day 1 now" [15], which lands on [T01, R03].
20. R03 Workout day (:1545). Tap "Start, everything's ready" [16], which opens R07. The first workout has started.
Total: about 20 screens and 16 taps, plus 11 phone digits and 6 code digits, plus two camera captures and one server wait. Her first welcome after verifying is a rules page, and her first sight of "her week" is screen 19.
Meal log path: on O05 tap "I will start tomorrow" (T01 day-one state). Tap "Tell us one thing you eat" (today_view.dart:607) to open E01 in its E09 day-one state, then tap "Log" on a starter (eat_view.dart:657-664). That is about 17 taps.
Diet plan: T01, then the Eat tab, then Recipes (E05), then Week plan (E07, app_router.dart:1786). That is about 18 taps.
Cycle log: My cycle is not on the day-one Home. The row exists only on the regular Home (today_view.dart:395-404). So on day one: avatar, A02, My cycle, Y01 setup, Y03, Y04 check-in. That is 20 or more taps.
coach_path: At launch: impossible. C08 hides the coach option when Feature.coachApp is off (app_router.dart:994), and C13 hides "I'm a coach, set up my profile" (youre_in_view.dart:107). As the code stands with the flag on: C01 Get started, C02 Continue, C03 Create my account, C06 phone, C07 code, C08 pick "I coach women" and Continue, then C09, C09b, C10, C10b, C11 and the C12 wait (the same check). At C13 the primary button is still "Read the three rules". The coach option is a secondary text button, "I'm a coach, set up my profile" (youre_in_view.dart:106-113), and it goes straight to K01, skipping the pledge (C16). Then K01 Basics, K02 Certificates, K03 Specialties, K04 Packages, K05 Payout (app_router.dart:2989-3069). In a production build (accountRequired on), onAddCertificate and onSetPayout are null (app_router.dart:3008, 3055), so a real coach cannot add a certificate or a payout method. K05 Continue submits her and opens K06 "Being checked" (:3070), which offers "Build first plan" (K20) or "See today" (K07). About 22 taps, roughly 18 screens. The one useful action at the end (build a split) waits behind certificate review that she cannot actually start. The invite-a-trainee and portfolio paths (W11, B14, B01) are reachable only from K07, after all of this.

taps_to_first_value.workout: About 16 taps across about 20 screens (C01 to R07), plus typing the phone number and code, two auto camera captures, one selfie and a server wait. The first 'this is yours' moment is O05 at about tap 15.
taps_to_first_value.diet: About 17 taps to log a first meal (O05 'I will start tomorrow', then Home 'Tell us one thing you eat', then E01 Log). About 18 taps to open a week meal plan (Home, Eat, Recipes, Week plan).
taps_to_first_value.log: About 17 taps for a first meal log, or 16 for a first logged set (R07). A first cycle log takes 20 or more taps, because My cycle is missing from the day-one Home and lives behind the avatar and A02.
taps_to_first_value.coach: Unreachable in the launch build (coachApp=false). With the flag on: about 22 taps to K06, ending in a submit-for-review. In production the certificate and payout rows are inert, so a real coach cannot finish setup in-app.

findings.title: Her week is promised last, after the paperwork
findings.where: Setup questions O01-O05, app_router.dart:1269-1373 and onboarding_state.dart isDue; gate at app_router.dart:565
findings.problem: The single most exciting thing the app can say, 'your week is ready, built from your four answers' (arb:465), comes at screen 19, after phone, code, role, ID, selfie, a wait, a success screen and a rules page. She meets the cost (ID, selfie, Google Cloud outside Egypt) before she has felt anything to protect. The setup flow is already ungated ('onboarding' is in openBeforeVerification, app_router.dart:565-570), so nothing in the women-only gate forces this order.
findings.evidence: Only C16 onAgree and C07 onConfirmed open O01 (app_router.dart:1271-1275, 980-983). isDue is false for any unverified woman when accountRequired is on.
findings.fix: Run O01-O05 right after C03 'Create my account', or straight from C01 'Get started'. End O05 with her personalised week card and one button, 'Save my week and join', which leads to C06. After C12/C13 she lands on the R03 she already chose. The answers already persist in IntakeRepository, and the verification gate and consent steps stay exactly as they are; only their position moves.

findings.title: The success moment hands her a rules page, not her program
findings.where: C13 You're in, youre_in_view.dart:104-114; C16 pledge_view.dart:40-70
findings.problem: The peak emotional screen ('You're in') sends her on with 'Read the three rules'. The rules are written for a community that is switched off at launch ('What is said here stays here', 'No comments on anyone else's body'). She reads three rules about a room she cannot enter yet, and the warning 'Break one and you lose your place'.
findings.evidence: arb keys readTheThreeRules, breakOneAndYouLoseYourPlace; community=false (feature_flags.dart:205).
findings.fix: Keep the pledge, because it protects the women-only promise. Make C13's primary button 'Start my week' and fold the pledge in as one compact agreement card on C13, or show it the first time she opens the community. If the setup questions have moved earlier, C13 should open R03 or her plan directly.

findings.title: 'Step 1 of 2' is a promise the flow breaks
findings.problem: She is told sign-up has two steps. After step 2 come about 7 more screens (role, why we check, consent, ID front, ID back, selfie, checking, rules) and then 5 setup screens. Broken expectations are the main reason people quit verification flows.
findings.evidence: arb:1055 'Step 1 of 2'; C07 to C08 to C09 to C09b to C10 to C10b to C11 to C12 to C13 to C16.
findings.fix: Use one honest progress frame across the whole signup: 'Your number, then a 90-second check'. Or show three named stages (Number · Check · Your week) with the current one marked.

findings.title: Role screen with one choice
findings.problem: With the coach app off, 'Which one are you?' offers only 'I'm here to train', already selected. It is a tap that asks nothing, sitting between the code and the ID check where momentum matters most.
findings.evidence: offerCoach: featureFlags.isOn(Feature.coachApp) (app_router.dart:994); coachApp=false.
findings.fix: When offerCoach is false, skip C08: set lastSignupRole = trainee, call beginIdentityCheck(), and go to C09 inside C07.onConfirmed. Keep C08 unchanged when the coach app is on.

findings.title: Look around is a locked shop window
findings.where: C04 look_around_view.dart:112-226; C14 'Look around while you wait' being_checked_view.dart:348
findings.problem: The one pre-account taste is two placeholder workouts. Tapping either immediately asks her to join. The Recipes tab switches the segment but still lists workouts. The bottom bar is drawn but has no onSelect. A woman waiting on a reviewer (C14) is sent here and finds nothing to do, during the hours when she is most likely to leave forever.
findings.evidence: onTap: () => _promptToJoin(context) (:178); the list renders `workouts` whatever _tab is; AppNavBar(activeScreenId: 'R01') with no onSelect (:135).
findings.fix: Let her play one real follow-along preview (an R04 move video) and open one real Rahma recipe read-only, before any join prompt. On C14, offer the ungated setup questions ('Build your week while we check') so the wait produces her plan. Content stays non-community, so the women-only gate is untouched.

findings.title: Day-one Home forgets everything she just told us
findings.problem: After four questions, Home reads 'Your training, week by week … This app counts weeks, not days'. It is generic, with no 'your 3 days · 20 minutes · at home', no program name and no echo of her goal. The aha from O05 evaporates one screen later.
findings.evidence: _dayOne draws yourTrainingWeekByWeek and thisAppCountsWeeksNotDaysAnd. The comment at :526-545 notes it is handed none of her intake.
findings.fix: Pass IntakeRepository.read() into TodayView. Day one then says 'Your week: {days} sessions, {minutes} min, {place}', the same line O05 shows (starting_program_view.dart:95-100), above 'Start day 1'.

findings.title: Her cycle is hidden on day one
findings.where: today_view.dart:395-404 (regular Home only) vs _dayOne :498-642; nav bar app_nav_bar.dart:58-76
findings.problem: Cycle tracking is one of the three promises (train, eat, track her cycle), and it is not a tab. On day one it is reachable only via avatar, A02 and the My cycle row. 'Log her data' for the cycle is the slowest of all first actions.
findings.evidence: The myCycle row is in the non-day-one branch only. The tabs are T01, R01, M01 (off) and E01.
findings.fix: Add one 'Set up My cycle' row to _dayOne beside 'Tell us one thing you eat'. It opens Y01, which already exists and writes nothing until she answers.

findings.title: Life stage copy undersells the whole setup
findings.problem: 'Nothing in your sessions changes from it yet' tells a pregnant or postpartum woman that her answer does nothing. It is honest, but it deflates the 'built for your body' promise at the exact point where she is trusting it.
findings.evidence: weSaveYourAnswerWithTheRest.
findings.fix: Keep it honest and frame it warmly: 'Saved. Your coach and our programmes use this as soon as your plan is ready. Tell your doctor's advice first.' Only claim what is true.

findings.title: Coach cannot finish setup in a real build
findings.problem: With accountRequired on, onAddCertificate and onSetPayout are null, so the rows are inert. A real coach is walked through five setup screens, two of which she cannot complete, and then K06 submits her for a review that has no certificate to review. Her first useful action (a plan, a portfolio, an invite) sits behind this.
findings.evidence: isTestMode => AppRouter.testingAidsAllowed, which is false whenever accountRequired is on.
findings.fix: Before turning coachApp on, wire a real certificate upload (Storage rules already exist per commit b6e26d8) and a payout capture. Reorder the coach path so K06 lands on 'Build your first plan' (K20) and 'Your portfolio' (B01) while the review runs, because building is not publishing.

findings.title: Coach branch is a secondary text link on C13 and skips the pledge
findings.problem: A woman who chose 'I coach women' at C08 still sees 'Read the three rules' as the main button, with her path as a small text link. If she follows the main button she gets the trainee intake (O01). If she follows the link she never sees the community pledge, even though coaches are the ones rule 3 (no selling) applies to most.
findings.evidence: YoureInView shows both buttons for any role; it never reads lastSignupRole.
findings.fix: Branch C13 on lastSignupRole. A coach gets primary 'Set up my coaching profile', which goes to a short pledge (or the same C16 with coach copy) and then K01. A trainee keeps her path. When the role is 'both', offer both.

findings.title: Stale gate comment contradicts the shipped flag
findings.problem: The router says the whole-app gate is 'built and switched off', but accountRequired ships true. Anyone reordering onboarding may misread which screens a new woman can reach.
findings.evidence: '**This is built and switched off.**' vs Feature.accountRequired: true.
findings.fix: Update the comment to say the gate ships on (2026-10-02), as testingAidsAllowed's note already does at :885-895.

keep: The women-only gate as a pure function: gateDestination/verificationGate (app_router.dart:805-858) and behindVerification with an unknown id treated as gated (:573-580). Every product route stays closed until the server says verified. It is the core promise.
openBeforeVerification = {signup, onboarding, account, admin} (app_router.dart:565). It is what lets setup move earlier, and it keeps PDPL deletion reachable for a refused woman.

C09b ConsentView as the only door to C10, with consentRecorded guarding deep links (app_router.dart:1031-1054). Consent is written before any lens opens, and 'I would rather not' leads to a woman reviewer.
The niqab path and the woman-reviewer fallback (C09 onNiqabPath leads to C15; C12 onAskForReviewer; C15 to C14). Nothing on these routes asks for a selfie, and no failure is a dead end.
C13 copy 'Your ID photo and selfie have been deleted. We kept the result and nothing else.' and the measured, never invented, duration (youre_in_view.dart:76-92, 160-171).

Welcome and What's inside copy, which already sells the promise: 'A room full of women training like you', 'No jumping, no equipment, ten minutes counts. Your neighbours will never know.', 'Koshari, ful and molokhia in the portions you actually serve. No grams, no calorie shaming.' (arb:375 and the C03 keys).

Setup design: every question preselects a valid answer, Skip on every step, and a working close X, and every exit calls OnboardingState.finish, which applies her days as her real weekly target (onboarding_state.dart finish/_applyWeeklyTarget). Her answer reaches the goal unclamped.
leaveSetupToHome clearing the signup stack so 'Start day 1 now' lands as [T01, R03] and back never returns to the pledge (onboarding_state.dart leaveSetupToHome).
C07 sends an already verified woman straight to Home or to setup, never through the ID check twice, after a bounded cloud pull (app_router.dart:956-985).
Empty states that act as onboarding: T06 'Start day 1' plus 'Tell us one thing you eat', and E09 one-tap starter plates (today_view.dart:498-642, eat_view.dart:635-671). No tours, no overlays.

The honesty rules: no invented program content (starting_program.dart header), no fake member counts, and no rows drawn for switched-off features (screenIsOn, app_router.dart:523-528). Fixes must not bring back claims the app cannot keep.
Language is selectable first and stays reachable from her profile (C02 in ungatedScreens, app_router.dart:505), with Arabic as MSA right to left.
verdict: Own Hub already has the soul of a great onboarding. Its welcome copy is warm, specific and Egyptian ('Koshari, ful and molokhia…', 'Your neighbours will never know'). Its verification is careful and kind (consent before the camera, a niqab path, a woman reviewer, images deleted and the screen says so). Its setup questions are short, skippable, and actually change her weekly goal. The problem is the order, not the parts. Today she pays the full price first: phone, code, a one-option role screen, ID front and back, a selfie and a wait, inside a frame that told her 'Step 1 of 2'. Then she reads three community rules for a community that is switched off, and only at screen 19 hears 'your week is ready, built from your four answers'. Day-one Home then forgets those answers, and the cycle promise is hidden behind her avatar. The code already permits the fix: setup is ungated. Move O01-O05 to right after 'Get started', end with her personalised week and 'Save my week and join', keep every verification and consent step intact behind that, and land her straight on Start day 1 after 'You're in'. She would then reach the women-only check already invested in something that is hers, which is the strongest reason any woman has to finish it. The coach side is not ready to judge on speed, because in a real build a coach cannot attach a certificate or a payout. It needs those wired, and a role-aware C13, before the flag goes on.

approach: I traced the real route graph in /Users/mahmoudreda/ownhub/.claude/worktrees/onboarding/app/lib/routing/app_router.dart, main.dart and onboarding_state.dart with the shipped flags (accountRequired, signUp and verification on; coachApp, community and marketplace off). I then read every signup, onboarding, Today and Eat view and the coach K01 to K06 wiring, and quoted the on-screen copy from lib/l10n/app_en.arb. I ran flutter analyze (no issues) and the signup, onboarding, journeys, routing and app_state suites (684 tests, all passed). Every point where a woman gives up is ranked by how many users it loses.
trainee_path:
Shipped build: accountRequired is on, so the front door is C01 and the setup questions are not due until she is verified (onboarding_state.dart:81-84).
1. C01 Welcome. Tap "Get started" (tap 1). "I already have an account" goes to C06.
2. C02 Language. Her phone language is preselected. Tap "Continue" (2).
3. C03 What's inside. Four marketing rows. Tap "Create my account" (3). "Look around first" goes to C04, which has two hard-coded rows. Every tap there opens a "Save this workout?" join sheet, the tabs show the same list, and the nav bar does nothing.
4. C06 "What's your number", titled "Step 1 of 2". She types her number (text field 1) and taps "Send me a code" (4). If sending fails, nothing happens on screen.
5. Wait for the SMS. C07 "Type the code", "Step 2 of 2". She types 6 digits (text field 2), which auto-submit. A wrong code just clears the boxes. Then there is an unannounced wait of up to about 3s or more while the claim is read.
6. C08 "Which one are you?" has a single option, "I'm here to train", because the coach app is off. Tap "Continue" (5).
7. C09 "One check, then you are in". Tap "Scan my ID" (6). The niqab option goes to C15 (woman reviewer).
8. C09b "Before the camera opens" (consent). Tap "I agree, start the camera" (7). "I would rather not" goes to C15.
9. The OS camera permission prompt: Allow (8). If she denies it, C10 is a dead screen.
10. C10 ID front. It auto-captures or she taps "Take it myself" (9).
11. C10b ID back (10). Then a network call starts the liveness session, with no spinner. A network failure here sends her to C15, the human video-call queue.
12. C11 selfie challenge steps, then "Done" (11).
13. C12 "Checking your card": a static ring at 72% with two ticks already drawn. It waits for the server. Its "Continue" button jumps to "You're in" before any decision. Branches: C14 waiting for a reviewer (the whole app stays locked, with no SMS or push), C10 retake, C15 reviewer, and stop screens.
14. C13 "You're in". Tap "Read the three rules" (12).
15. C16 community pledge: "Break one and you lose your place". Tap "I agree, let me in" (13).
16. O01 to O04 are labelled "1 of 4" to "4 of 4". Each has a preselected answer plus Continue, Skip (which does the same as Continue) and an X that skips all setup. That is 4 taps (14 to 17).
17. O05 "Your starting program". It is always "Beginner foundations · 8 weeks · quiet · no equipment", whatever she answered. Tap "Start day 1 now" (18). The stack is cleared to [T01, R03].
18. R03 Workout day. Tap Start (19). R07 means the workout has started.
In total: about 19 taps, 2 typed fields, 1 SMS wait, 1 OS permission, 1 server verification wait and 21 screens to the first set. The fastest legal path uses the X on O01: 14 taps to Home, then "Start day 1" and "Start", which is 16 taps.
Diet: at O05 tap "I will start tomorrow" (18). Home day one shows "Tell us one thing you eat" (19). E01 day one, then "Log" on a starter plate (20).
Cycle log: Home, then avatar to A02 (19), "My cycle" to Y03 (20), "Set up" to Y01 (21), then the Y02 dates. That is about 23 to 24 taps. There is no cycle tab and nothing about the cycle on day-one Home.
coach_path:
This exists in code only. coachApp is off, so C08 never offers the coach role and C13 hides the coach link.
1. C01 to C07 are the same as for a trainee: 4 taps, phone number and code.
2. C08: pick "I coach women" and Continue (5 to 6).
3. C09 to C12: the same ID and selfie check (7 to 12).
4. C13 "You're in". The primary button is "Read the three rules", which takes a coach into the trainee pledge, the trainee goal questions and trainee Home. Coach setup is the secondary text button "I'm a coach, set up my profile" (13).
5. K01 Your basics: 3 text fields (name, city, one line about you), then Continue (14).
6. K02 Certificates. With accountRequired on, the add-certificate row does nothing because onAddCertificate is null outside test mode. Continue (15).
7. K03 What you coach (16).
8. K04 Your packages: up to 4 fields (17).
9. K05 Getting paid. Payout is "unavailable, not implemented" in production. Continue (18).
10. K06 Being checked. "Build your first plan" goes to K20 (19). "See today" goes to K07, the desk, where the portfolio entry B01 is.
That is about 19 taps and 7 or more text fields to the first plan. The profile, plans and portfolio are held in memory only and are lost when the app restarts. There is no way to invite a trainee: the marketplace is off and no invite flow exists.

The minimum is 16 using the X on O01. Nothing is playable before verification.
taps_to_first_value.diet: About 20 taps to the first meal logged (O05 'I will start tomorrow' > Home 'Tell us one thing you eat' > starter plate 'Log'). A week meal plan (E07) is further away still and is not offered on day one.

findings.title: Nothing of value is reachable before a 13-tap ID and selfie gauntlet, and even the 4 setup questions wait for verification
findings.problem: A woman who does not yet know what the app does is asked for her phone number, her national ID front and back, and a live selfie before she sees one real workout, recipe or personal plan. The only preview, C04, is two hard-coded titles, and tapping either opens 'Save this workout?'. The O01 to O05 questions are ungated routes, yet isDue is false until verification, so even the 'your plan' payoff comes after the scariest ask. This is the single largest drop-off point in the product.
findings.evidence: onboarding_state.dart:81-84: `!setupDone && (!accountRequired || AppRouter.isVerified)`. main.dart _firstRunStack only stacks O01 when isDue. look_around_view.dart:122-133 hard-codes 'Quiet full body' and 'Floor legs, no jumping', and every onTap calls _promptToJoin.
findings.fix: Keep the gate but reorder. Change C03 'Create my account' so it goes to O01-O05 first (they are already in openBeforeVerification). Set isDue to `!setupDone` alone. End O05 with her plan and day-1 moves visible, then 'Save my plan and start' leads to C06 and onward to C09. Replace C04 with that same real day-1 preview. The owner should decide whether the local-only day-1 sample session can run before the check, which would be deferring the gate rather than deleting it.

findings.title: The C12 'Continue' button announces 'You're in' before the check has decided, then bounces her back to the start of the check
findings.problem: While the server is still checking, a live Continue button pushes C13 'You're in'. She then agrees to the pledge and answers the setup questions. When she lands on Home, the gate (gateDestination) sends her to C09 'One check, then you are in'. She believes she is verified and is told to start again. The C12 listener is still mounted under the stack, so a real verdict arriving later pushes another C13 on top of whatever she is doing. The screen also draws 'Card read ✓' and 'Selfie matched ✓' and a 72% ring before anything is known.
findings.evidence: checking_view.dart:241 `footer: [AppButton(l10n.continueLabel, onPressed: widget.onContinue)]`. app_router.dart:1167 `onContinue: () => goTo(context, 'C13')`. checking_view.dart:39 `this.fraction = 0.72`. Lines 274 and 279 hard-code `done: true`.
findings.fix: Remove onContinue from C12. After 20 seconds with no verdict, show 'Taking longer than usual' with 'Ask a woman reviewer' and 'Try again'. Drive the ticks from the real state, or use an indeterminate spinner.

findings.title: Phone and code errors are swallowed: offline, invalid number, rate limit and wrong or expired code all do nothing visible
findings.problem: These are the first two input screens. On C06 any AuthException (network, invalidNumber, tooManyAttempts) leaves her on the same screen with the button re-enabled and no message. On C07 a wrong or expired code silently clears the six boxes. A woman on weak Egyptian mobile data taps 'Send me a code' three times, nothing happens, and she uninstalls.
findings.evidence: phone_number_view.dart:100 `} on AuthException { // No failure copy exists in the dictionary yet`. code_view.dart:126-129 `on AuthException { if (mounted) _controller.clear(); }`. AuthFailure has invalidNumber, invalidCode, codeExpired, tooManyAttempts and network (auth_repository.dart:55-62).
findings.fix: Map each AuthFailure to one inline line in both languages under the field, for example 'That code did not match. Try again or send a new one.' and 'No connection. Your number is kept, try again.' For codeExpired, focus the 'Send it again' button.

findings.title: Arabic-keyboard digits keep 'Send me a code' disabled forever
findings.problem: Most users are on Arabic phones. C06 strips everything except ASCII 0-9 before deciding whether the button is live. So a number typed as ٠١٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨, from Samsung or Gboard Arabic numerals or pasted from Contacts, counts as 0 digits and the button never enables. No error is shown either. The repository already handles these digits, but the screen never gets that far.
findings.evidence: phone_number_view.dart:79 `_controller.text.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9]'), '')`. firebase_auth_repository.dart:80-83 says: 'The Arabic-Indic case cannot be produced by C06 today, because that screen filters the field to ASCII digits before it decides whether the button is live.'
findings.fix: Use `asciiDigits(_controller.text)` from firebase_auth_repository.dart:121 in `_digits`. Add a widget test that types Arabic-Indic digits.

findings.title: A denied camera permission leaves a dead screen with no explanation and no way forward
findings.problem: The camera prompt arrives right after a consent screen about Google Cloud and servers outside Egypt, so many women will tap Don't allow. The service then emits CaptureUnavailable(permissionDenied), but neither capture screen renders it. She sees an empty frame labelled 'Front of the card' and a disabled 'Take it myself' button. There is no 'Open settings' and no route to the woman reviewer from here.
findings.evidence: grep finds no use of `CaptureUnavailable` or `permissionDenied` anywhere in lib/features/signup/presentation or lib/ui. id_capture_view sets `onAction: _state.isLive ? _capture : null`. camera_capture_service.dart:221-224 maps 'denied' to permissionDenied.
findings.fix: In CaptureScaffold, render CaptureUnavailable with one sentence, an 'Open settings' button (permission_handler openAppSettings) and 'Check me with a woman reviewer instead', which goes to C15 with ReviewPath.declined.

findings.title: A network blip at the end of the ID scan sends her to the human video-call queue instead of a retry, and it is never logged
findings.problem: When she finishes the back of her card, startLiveness calls the server. Any failure classified as `other`, which includes a dropped connection, becomes LivenessStart.failed and pushes her to C15, the reviewer booking. That path ends on C14 with the whole app locked until a person phones her. One flaky moment of 4G turns a 90-second check into days of waiting. Nobody can see how often this happens.
findings.evidence: identity_check.dart:142 `CallFailureKind.retake || CallFailureKind.other => LivenessStart.failed`. app_router.dart:1090-1095 `case LivenessStart.failed: pendingReviewPath = ReviewPath.error; goTo(context, 'C15');`. identity_check.dart:132 says 'Logged by nobody on purpose'.
findings.fix: Split network failures out of `other`. For those, stay on C10b with 'No connection, your photos are still here. Try again', and offer the reviewer only after 2 failed retries. Count each LivenessStart outcome as a non-identifying analytics event.

findings.title: Progress labels lie: 'Step 1 of 2', 'Step 2 of 2', then 17 more screens; '90 seconds' and 'about two minutes'
findings.problem: She is told sign-up is 2 steps. After step 2 come role, why we check, consent, ID front, ID back, selfie, checking, you're in, pledge, then '1 of 4' setup questions and a fifth screen. Each broken promise raises the urge to quit. 'Join · about two minutes' on C04 and 'It takes about 90 seconds' on C09 set the same false expectation.
findings.evidence: ARB 1055 "step1Of2": "Step 1 of 2". ARB 680 "joinAboutTwoMinutes". ARB 679 "itTakesAbout90Seconds". intake_step_scaffold.dart:76 `static const int totalSteps = 4;` while O05 is the fifth screen.
findings.fix: Use one persistent 3-stage indicator across the whole flow, for example 'Your plan · Your number · Your check', with the current stage filled. Drop per-screen step counts and say 'about 3 minutes' honestly.

findings.title: During human review she is locked out of everything and is never told when she is approved
findings.problem: Niqab users, women who decline the camera and anyone the automatic check flags all land on C14. Nothing opens, not even the setup questions, because isDue requires verified. The copy says 'We do not send text messages about this', and there is no push notification. Her only action is 'Look around while you wait', which leads to the fake two-row C04. She has to remember to reopen the app.
findings.evidence: ARB 3104: 'A woman reviewer from Own Hub will phone you to arrange a short video call. We do not send text messages about this.' app_router.dart:1205-1211: 'Nothing is open to her while she waits'. onboarding_state.dart:81-84.
findings.fix: Let her finish O01-O05 and see her plan while she waits (setup is already ungated). Send a push notification on approval, give an expected wait such as 'usually within 24 hours', and show a 'what happens next' timeline.

findings.title: At the scariest step, the privacy copy contradicts itself and offers a dead 'Tap to read'
findings.problem: C09 says 'Checked by Own Hub's own system… Tap to read exactly what is kept.' The very next screen, C09b, says 'The photographs are processed by Google Cloud, on servers outside Egypt.' The 'tap to read' line is plain Text, not a link. A suspicious user reads this as a bait-and-switch right before handing over her national ID.
findings.evidence: why_we_check_view.dart:99-102 renders `Text(l10n.checkedByOwnHubsOwnSystemYour)` with no onTap. ARB 3098 vs ARB 2854.
findings.fix: Rewrite C09 to match C09b: 'Checked by Own Hub, using Google Cloud. Photos are deleted when the check ends.' Either remove 'Tap to read' or make it open a details sheet.

findings.title: The role screen asks 'Which one are you?' with only one answer
findings.problem: With coachApp off, C08 shows a single preselected card, 'I'm here to train', and a Continue button. It is a wasted screen and tap, and it hints that she is missing something.
findings.evidence: app_router.dart:994 `offerCoach: featureFlags.isOn(Feature.coachApp)`. role_view.dart:129 `if (widget.offerCoach) ...[` hides the other two cards.
findings.fix: When offerCoach is false, skip C08. Set the trainee role in C07 onConfirmed and go straight on.

findings.title: A community pledge with a threat blocks entry while the community is switched off
findings.problem: Right after 'You're in', she must agree to 'What is said here stays here', 'No comments on anyone else's body' and 'Break one and you lose your place'. These rules cover a community that does not exist at launch. It is an extra screen with a punitive tone at the moment she should feel welcomed. Agreeing also records nothing (onAgree only sets a flag).
findings.evidence: ARB 456 "breakOneAndYouLoseYourPlace". feature_flags.dart: `Feature.community: false`. app_router.dart:1270-1274: onAgree only sets enteredFromSignup and opens O01.
findings.fix: When community is off, cut C16. Make C13's primary button 'Build my week', which goes to the setup questions or plan. Show the pledge, and record it, the first time she opens the community.

findings.title: The setup promises a personalised plan, but every answer produces the same programme
findings.problem: O01 says 'Pick one. It changes the program, not the app.' O05 says 'Built from your four answers'. The catalogue holds one entry, so a gym user with dumbbells who answered 'pregnant' gets 'Beginner foundations · 8 weeks · quiet · no equipment'. Only her days per week change anything. Users who notice stop trusting the app on day one.
findings.evidence: starting_program.dart:113 `const List<StartingProgram> kStartingProgramCatalogue = [beginnerFoundations];`. onboarding_state.dart's own doc: 'The other four answers are recorded and, today, consumed only by O05's own programme preview'.
findings.fix: Until there is content, ask only what changes something (days and minutes, plus a place question if kept) and make the copy honest, for example 'Your first program. We will tune it as you train.' That cuts the walk to 2 screens.

findings.title: 'Skip' and 'Continue' do the same thing on every setup question, while 'X' skips all of setup
findings.problem: Every question is preselected. Both onSkip and onContinue go to the next step, so two buttons mean the same thing and the X means something else. The lead line 'Skip any of them' adds to the confusion about what 'Skip' changes.
findings.evidence: app_router.dart:1300-1301 `onContinue: () => goTo(context, 'O02'), onSkip: () => goTo(context, 'O02')`, and the same pattern for O02 to O04.
findings.fix: Remove the per-question Skip, since a default is already picked. Keep one quiet 'Skip setup' link that leads to O05 with the defaults shown.

findings.title: The 'Look around' preview has tabs that change nothing and a nav bar that does nothing
findings.problem: The 'Recipes' tab still lists the two workouts. The bottom nav (Home, Train, Eat) is drawn with no onSelect, so tapping it does nothing. Every item opens a join sheet. Curious users feel trapped.
findings.evidence: look_around_view.dart:163 `for (final workout in workouts)` ignores `_tab`. Line 140 has `const AppNavBar(activeScreenId: 'R01')` with no onSelect. app_nav_bar.dart:144-146 makes the tap null when onSelect is null.
findings.fix: Remove the nav bar from C04. Make each tab show its own content, with one real playable sample move and one real recipe from the bundled seed.

findings.title: After the code is accepted there is a silent wait, the button comes back to life, and a double tap pushes the role screen twice
findings.problem: onConfirmed is an async closure that is not awaited. `_checking` resets right away while the router waits up to 3s or more for the claim and status reads (and a cloud pull for returning users), with no spinner. A second tap calls confirmCode, which returns early because she is signed in, then onConfirmed again, which pushes C08 twice. If the auth state is not AuthAwaitingCode, the screen says the code went to a stranger's number, '+20 100 555 0132'.
findings.evidence: code_view.dart:125 `widget.onConfirmed?.call();` then `finally { _checking = false }`. code_view.dart:116 fallback `'+20 100 555 0132'`.
findings.fix: Change onConfirmed to a Future<void> Function(), await it inside the try, and keep `_checking` true with a spinner until it completes. Replace the hard-coded number with an empty string.

findings.title: Cycle tracking, a core promise, is buried four taps deep behind the avatar
findings.problem: There is no cycle tab and no setup question about it. Day-one Home shows no cycle entry because showCycleCard defaults to false. The only way in is avatar, then Profile, then 'My cycle', then 'Set up'. A user who installed for cycle tracking cannot find it.
findings.evidence: today_day.dart:157 `this.showCycleCard = false`. today_view.dart:394 `if (_day.showCycleCard)`. The only fresh-user route to Y03 is A02 onOpenCycle (app_router.dart:1955).
findings.fix: Add a 'Track your cycle (optional)' row to day-one Home that opens Y01, and optionally an O-step 'Do you want to track your cycle?' that leads into Y01 after setup.

findings.title: Coach setup cannot be completed in the shipped configuration: certificates do nothing and payout is not implemented
findings.problem: With accountRequired on, testingAidsAllowed is false, so isTestMode is false. K02's add-certificate row is inert (onAddCertificate null) and K05 shows payout as unavailable. Turning the coachApp flag on would leave every real coach unable to finish K01 to K06 or be cleared.
findings.evidence: app_router.dart:3007-3010 `onAddCertificate: CoachProfileState.isTestMode ? ... : null`. coach_profile_state.dart:49 `static bool get isTestMode => AppRouter.testingAidsAllowed;` and lines 77-81 `PayoutMethodState.unavailable(PaymentUnavailableReason.notImplemented)`.
findings.fix: Before turning coachApp on, build certificate photo upload to Storage plus the review queue. Let her finish setup without a payout ('Add payout later') so she can reach her desk and her first plan.

findings.title: The coach's profile, portfolio and plans live only in memory and vanish when the app restarts
findings.where: lib/routing/app_router.dart (InMemoryCoachRepository and coachRepository); lib/app_state/app_snapshot.dart:1576-1584; lib/app_state/cloud_store.dart (no coach references)
findings.problem: A coach types her name, city and bio, specialties and packages, and builds a plan. If she closes the app, all of it is gone. That is the fastest way to lose a coach permanently.
findings.evidence: app_snapshot.dart:1576 says 'Community and coaching are not in the snapshot'. `grep -c coach lib/app_state/cloud_store.dart` returns 0.
findings.fix: Make coach profile and setup persistence (local snapshot plus Firestore) a release prerequisite for coachApp, enforced in release_readiness_test.

findings.title: After verification a coach is steered into the trainee pledge, the trainee goal questions and trainee Home
findings.problem: On C13 the primary button for everyone is 'Read the three rules', which goes to C16, then O01 'What do you want most?', then T01. 'I'm a coach, set up my profile' is a small text button. A coach who follows the obvious button answers trainee questions and ends up on trainee Home.
findings.evidence: youre_in_view.dart:105 `AppButton(l10n.readTheThreeRules, onPressed: onReadTheRules)` and line 110, a text-variant button for imACoachSetUpMyProfile. leaveSetupToHome defaults to `home: 'T01'`.
findings.fix: Branch on lastSignupRole. For coach or both, C13's primary button is 'Set up my coach profile', which goes to K01, and the trainee setup is skipped.

findings.title: Coach setup's Back buttons push new screens instead of going back, so the history keeps growing
findings.problem: On K02 to K05, Back calls goTo on the previous step, which pushes a new copy. A system back gesture then walks forward again, a classic back-button trap.
findings.evidence: app_router.dart:3013 `onBack: () => goTo(context, 'K01')`, and the same pattern for K03 to K05.
findings.fix: Use `Navigator.of(context).maybePop()` for onBack on K02 to K05, as K01 already does.

findings.title: There is no funnel measurement, so drop-off at each step is invisible
findings.where: lib/domain/analytics/analytics_gateway.dart (signUpStarted, verificationSubmitted, intakeCompleted and more are defined); no call sites in lib
findings.problem: A privacy-safe analytics API with exactly the onboarding events exists, but nothing calls it. The team cannot know whether women quit at C06, C09b, the camera prompt or C14, or confirm that any fix worked.
findings.evidence: `grep -rn AnalyticsGateway lib` returns nothing outside lib/domain/analytics. identity_check.dart:132 says 'Logged by nobody on purpose'.
findings.fix: Wire screenViewed for C01 to O05, plus signUpStarted, verificationSubmitted, verificationDecided (outcome as an enum only), intakeCompleted and the first sessionStarted or mealLogged. All are enum props and contain no personal data.

findings.title: The language screen is redundant and can show a different language from the one the app is using
findings.problem: main.dart already opens in the phone's language. C02 is an extra screen before any value. For a phone set to a third language, the app runs in English while C02 ticks Arabic, and pressing Continue without tapping saves neither.
findings.evidence: language_view `_effective` falls back to 'ar' for any non-'en' locale. main.dart `_firstRunLocale` falls back to 'en'.
findings.fix: Drop C02 from the first-run path and put an 'English | العربية' toggle on C01. Keep C02 for Profile.

findings.title: Health backup is off by default and never offered, so a new phone means lost history and setup again
findings.problem: Her logs and setup stay only on the phone unless she finds the toggle in the privacy centre. A broken or replaced phone wipes everything, and the code itself notes she will be asked the setup questions again.
findings.evidence: health_backup.dart:73 `bool _enabled = false;`. onboarding_state.dart:78-80: 'a verified woman whose setup is not done is one who came back on a new phone with the health backup off'.
findings.fix: After her first logged session, show one optional card: 'Keep a backup so a new phone has your history', which leads to the existing health-consent flow. The legally required consent is kept, only placed at a moment when its value is clear.

keep: Phone language detection at launch (main.dart _firstRunLocale): an Arabic phone opens in Arabic with no chooser needed.
The setup questions preselect valid answers and every way out (Continue, Skip, X, back) records setup as done. Nobody gets trapped in setup (onboarding_state.dart leaveSetup and finish).
Leaving setup after sign-up clears the whole sign-up stack, so back on Home cannot reach the pledge or the camera (leaveSetupToHome).
'Start day 1 now' on O05 lands as [T01, R03], one tap from a started workout. Day-one Home has a clear 'Start day 1' button and one-tap starter plates on Eat.
The consent screen (C09b) is the only route into the camera, the consent write must succeed first, and 'I would rather not' leads to a real alternative (the woman reviewer), as does the niqab path.
The code auto-submits on the sixth digit, the button is disabled until a full code is entered, and the screen shows her own number so typos are visible.
C12 and C14 have honest stop states with a clear action ('Try again', 'Ask for a woman reviewer', 'Sign in again', delete my data).
Home and Eat show 'Looking for what you have logged' for at most 5 seconds instead of falsely claiming she has no data (pending_answers.dart).
The route-level gate and the unknown-route fallback, which mean no blank white screen and no deep-link bypass.
684 passing tests and a clean analyzer. Keep the journeys and nav_reachability suites as the safety net for the reorder.
verdict: The app after onboarding is good: day-one Home has a clear 'Start day 1', Eat logs a starter plate in one tap, and every setup exit is safe. The way in loses most women before they ever see it. A first-time user who does not know what Own Hub is gets 3 brochure screens, then phone and SMS, then a one-option role screen, then a national ID front and back and a selfie. Only after that does she get a community pledge for a community that is switched off, and only then does she get the four questions that would have told her what the app does for her. That is about 19 taps, 2 typed fields and 21 screens to the first set, under 'Step 1 of 2' and '90 seconds' labels that are false. The worst failures are silent: send-code and wrong-code errors show nothing, Arabic-keyboard digits keep the send button disabled, and a denied camera permission leaves a dead screen. A network blip sends her to a human video-call queue where the whole app, setup included, is locked and nothing tells her she was approved. A live 'Continue' on the checking screen tells her 'You're in' before any decision and then sends her back to the check. The coach path cannot be completed in the shipped configuration (inert certificates, no payout, memory-only data) and its main button leads coaches into trainee setup. None of this needs the verification gate removed. Move the setup questions and a real day-1 preview in front of the phone and ID steps (they are already ungated), surface every error, cut C02, C08 and C16 while their features are off, keep the setup open during review, and wire the analytics events that already exist so the funnel can be measured.

approach: I treated install to first workout, meal or log as an activation funnel. I traced the real route order from main.dart, app_router.dart, onboarding_state.dart and feature_flags.dart, then counted screens, taps, inputs and waits, and scored each leak by Impact (1-5), Effort (S/M/L) and Confidence (Evidence/Assumption). Glob and Grep were unavailable (no rg on this machine), so I read files directly. COUNCIL_REPORT.md, DECISIONS_NEEDED.md and the other repo notes do not exist at the stated paths. I had no Advocate output, so I could not check PROTECTS CORE alternatives against it. Every drop-off figure below is an assumption, because the app has no analytics.
trainee_path:
Shipped flags: accountRequired, signUp and verification are on. Community, coach, marketplace and assistant are off (feature_flags.dart:188-216). On first launch the stack is just [C01], because OnboardingState.isDue stays false until she is verified (onboarding_state.dart:81-84, main.dart:339).

1. C01 Welcome. Tap "Get started" (tap 1).
2. C02 Language, already set from the phone's locale. Tap Continue (tap 2).
3. C03 What's inside: 3 promises. Tap "Create my account" (tap 3). The other choice, "Look around first", goes to C04, which shows preview workouts that do not exist yet. Tapping one only raises a "Join" sheet (look_around_view.dart:12-15, 84-110). Nothing can be started.
4. C06 Phone number: one text field. Tap send (tap 4). Then she waits for the SMS.
5. C07 Code: 6 digits, auto-checked on the last digit. A wrong code just clears the boxes with no message (code_view.dart:126-130).
6. C08 "Which one are you?" With the coach app off it shows exactly one card. Tap Continue (tap 5).
7. C09 Why we check. Tap scan (tap 6). The niqab path goes to C15.
8. C09b Before the camera opens. Tap "I agree, start the camera" (tap 7). "I would rather not" goes to C15.
9. C10 ID front (tap 8). She needs the physical card with her.
10. C10b ID back (tap 9). Then a server call to start liveness.
11. C11 Selfie with a liveness challenge (tap 10).
12. C12 Checking: server wait, no back button.
13. Branches out of C12:
   - Verified: C13 "You're in".
   - Review: C14, where nothing is open until a woman reviewer approves (app_router.dart:1205-1236). Time to value becomes hours or days.
   - Daily limit or no network: back to the front door, blocked.
   - Retake: back to C10.
14. C13. The primary button is "Read the three rules" (tap 11).
15. C16 Community pledge, although the community is off at launch. Tap "I agree, let me in" (tap 12).
16. O01 Goal (tap 13), O02 Place (tap 14), O03 Days and minutes (tap 15), O04 Life stage (tap 16). Every question has a preselected answer plus Skip.
17. O05 Your starting programme. Tap "Start day 1 now" (tap 17). The stack becomes [T01, R03].
18. R03 Workout day. Tap start (tap 18), then the first set.

Totals on the automatic happy path:
- First workout started: about 20 screens, 18-19 taps, 2 typed inputs (phone and OTP), 3 camera captures, 1 SMS wait, 2 server waits.
- First meal planned: "I'll start tomorrow" on O05, then T01, Eat tab, week plan. About 20-21 taps.
- First log saved: T01, then a Home plate tap, or "Tell us what you eat", then E02, type, save. About 19-21 taps.
- Review path: no value at all until a human approves.
coach_path:
At launch: zero. Feature.coachApp, coachPlanning and coachPortfolio are all off (feature_flags.dart:210-213). C08 offers only the trainee card (app_router.dart:994), and C13 hides the coach button (youre_in_view.dart:108). No coach can be acquired.

As written in code with the flag on:
1. C01, C02, C03, C06, C07: the same 4 taps, phone input and OTP as the trainee.
2. C08: choose "I coach women" and tap Continue (2 taps).
3. C09 to C12: the full women-only ID and selfie check (5 taps and waits).
4. C13: tap "I'm a coach, set up my profile". This skips the pledge and setup.
5. K01 Basics: name, city, tagline, blur toggle.
6. K02 Certificates.
7. K03 What you coach.
8. K04 Packages.
9. K05 Getting paid.
10. K06 Being checked: certificate review. While she waits, K06 offers "build your first plan" templates. Publishing is blocked until approval.

Roughly 19-20 taps, 6+ forms and 2 human or server reviews before a first useful coach action. Even then she cannot invite or reach a trainee, because the marketplace is off.

taps_to_first_value.workout: 18-19 taps over about 20 screens on the automatic path, plus phone entry, OTP, 3 captures, an SMS wait and 2 server waits. The review path gets nothing until a human approves (indefinite). My estimate is 6-10 minutes at best; that is an assumption, nothing measures it.
taps_to_first_value.diet: About 20-21 taps: the full sign-up and check, then C13, C16, O01-O05 'I'll start tomorrow', T01, Eat, then Week plan. There is no diet entry inside onboarding itself.
taps_to_first_value.log: About 19-21 taps: the full sign-up and check, then setup, then a Home plate tap or 'Tell us what you eat' to E02 and save. Nothing can be logged before verification.
taps_to_first_value.coach: Not reachable at launch, because coachApp is off. With the flag on, about 19-20 taps, 6+ forms (K01-K05) and 2 reviews (ID check and certificates) before she can author a plan. She cannot invite a trainee, because the marketplace is off.

findings.title: F1. The whole-app gate holds every local-only feature behind ID plus selfie plus server or human review. Impact 5, Effort M, Evidence
findings.where: Gate: app_router.dart:565-570 (openBeforeVerification) and :801-848 (gateDestination). Flags: feature_flags.dart:157-160 and 188-190. C14: app_router.dart:1205-1213
findings.problem: Every launch feature (Today, Train, Eat, Cycle, Progress) runs entirely on her phone, with no network and no other women in it. The community is off. Even so, she cannot start one workout or log one meal until the server says verified. On the review path (C14) she gets nothing for hours or days, and the only thing open is C04, which shows previews of content that does not exist. This is where most of the funnel is lost: 100% of review-path users and everyone who stalls at the camera get zero value. The size of that loss is an assumption, since nothing is measured.
findings.fix: This is the highest-impact item, and it is a product decision the owner has to make. The hard constraint allows deferring verification until it is needed, so move the gate to the features that involve other people or server data: community, coaching, marketplace and cloud backup. Then let a phone-verified (OTP) woman use the local-only Train, Eat and Cycle while her ID check runs or waits for review. Change openBeforeVerification so it also covers the local-only flows, scoped to signedIn. Keep the server rules exactly as they are. Show a quiet 'Finish your check to keep your data backed up and join the women-only space' banner on Home. How we'll know: the share of installs that start a first workout within 24 hours, and C14 users who still log at least 1 session while they wait. Both need F4's counters.

findings.title: F2. Setup questions O01-O05 come after the hardest step, so her own plan never pulls her through the check. Impact 4, Effort S-M, Evidence
findings.where: onboarding_state.dart:81-84 (isDue needs isVerified). app_router.dart:1269-1277 (the only door is C16). starting_program_view.dart:132-160
findings.problem: The only screen that shows her 'Built from your four answers' and a named programme sits at step 17 of 20, after the ID card, the selfie and the pledge. She is asked for her national ID before the app has shown it understands her. Payoff comes after cost, the worst order for completion.
findings.fix: Run O01-O04 straight after C03, before C06. They write locally and are already ungated. Then show O05's programme card with the button 'Save my plan, takes 2 minutes', which leads into the phone and ID steps. After C13, jump straight to R03 or Home. How we'll know: the C06-to-C13 completion rate goes up compared with the current baseline.

findings.title: F3. A mandatory community pledge for a community that is switched off, as C13's main button. Impact 3, Effort S, Evidence
findings.where: youre_in_view.dart:105 ("Read the three rules" is the primary CTA). app_router.dart:1202 and 1269-1277. feature_flags.dart:205
findings.problem: Her payoff moment ends with homework: 'Read the three rules' and a pledge whose footer threatens 'Break one and you lose your place', all about a feature that does not exist at launch. That is an extra screen and a wrong first impression right before the first workout.
findings.fix: When Feature.community is off, change C13's CTA to 'Start my first workout', which goes to O05 or R03 (or to O01 if F2 is not done). Show C16 the first time she opens the community. The pledge is a house rule, not the legally required consent record, so deferring it until needed is allowed. How we'll know: C13 to first R03 start in the same session.

findings.title: F4. There is no funnel instrumentation, so none of this can be measured. Impact 5 (risk), Effort M, Evidence
findings.where: pubspec.yaml:30-84 (no analytics package). The cycle no-analytics guard is described at pubspec.yaml:99-105
findings.problem: No event shows where women drop between C01 and R03. Every drop-off estimate in this audit is an assumption. Without data the team cannot tell whether a fix worked, and cannot defend the verification cost to investors or the owner.
findings.fix: Add a privacy-safe step counter: one anonymous 'reached screen X' increment per onboarding screen (C01-C13, C14, O01-O05, R03 started, R10 finished, first E04). No uid, no health or cycle data, and keep the existing cycle guard. A Firestore aggregate document or Firebase Analytics with ad ID and personalisation disabled would both work. Declare it in the privacy manifest. How we'll know: a daily funnel chart exists and adds up from C01 to R03.

findings.title: F5. Nothing brings her back on day 2 or day 7. Impact 4, Effort M, Evidence
findings.where: pubspec.yaml (no notifications or messaging plugin). notifications.dart:44-47 (MVP notification set unresolved). notifications.dart:21-30 (daily counters forbidden by rule)
findings.problem: After the first session nothing triggers a return: no local reminder and no push. A01 is an inbox with no delivery behind it. The product rules forbid daily streaks, and that is right for this product, but nothing replaces them. The weekly 'counts when you finish your week' loop exists on screen and has no way to reach her phone.
findings.fix: Add local notifications only (no server needed). On O05, after 'Start day 1 now', ask once: 'Remind me on my training days?' Schedule from O03's days and minutes, plus one Sunday 'your week so far' note. Stay weekly, never use daily streak copy, and stop after 3 ignored reminders as A01 already promises. How we'll know: day-2 and day-7 return rate from F4, with and without reminder opt-in.

findings.title: F6. A wrong OTP clears silently with no message. Impact 3, Effort S, Evidence
findings.problem: At step 5, a mistyped or expired code just empties the boxes. She cannot tell whether the app is broken, the code expired, or she is offline. A silent failure this early tends to make people quit (assumption, not measured).
findings.fix: Wire the strings that already exist ('That code is not right', 'That code has expired', the offline copy from i18n states) into the AuthException branch, with a resend link next to them. How we'll know: OTP-screen exits fall, and so do resend counts per success.

findings.title: F7. The release order can lock out every woman. Impact 5 (risk), Effort S, Evidence
findings.problem: accountRequired ships on. If the functions are not deployed or reachable, start_verification and verify_identity fail and every woman waits on C14 for a call nothing books. That is a 100% activation loss and a wave of 1-star reviews on day one. Only a comment in the code guards against it.
findings.fix: Add a release-blocking smoke test that verifies one real account end to end on the closed track. Add a startup check that reaches the functions: if it fails, C14 says plainly that checks are paused and offers to notify her, instead of promising a reviewer. How we'll know: the release checklist has a recorded pass, and C14 entries with no booked review stay near zero.

findings.title: F8. Screens that do nothing in this build: a role choice with one option, and a language screen that repeats the auto-detected language. Impact 2, Effort S, Evidence
findings.where: role_view.dart:121-145 and app_router.dart:994 (one card). main.dart:194-210 (locale already detected). app_router.dart:910-921 (C02 then C03)
findings.problem: Two of the first six screens ask her nothing: C08 offers a single card, and C02 confirms a language the phone already supplied. Each extra tap before value is a place to quit, and C02 to C03 stretches the pitch over 3 screens.
findings.fix: Skip C08 when offerCoach is false. Call onContinue(trainee) directly; beginIdentityCheck still runs. Replace C02 on the first run with an EN/عربي toggle on C01, and keep C02 reachable from A02. This saves 2 taps and 2 screens. How we'll know: the C01-to-C06 rate.

findings.title: F9. Setup asks 4 questions but only 'days' changes anything. Impact 2, Effort S, Evidence
findings.problem: The catalogue has one programme, so goal, place and life stage all lead to beginner_foundations. 'Pick a different program' lands on the workout library. That is 4 screens of effort for one variable. It is cheap once F2 moves them earlier, but each one still costs a tap.
findings.fix: Keep O03 (days and minutes) and O04 (life stage, safety-critical). Make O01 and O02 single-screen chips or defer them until a second programme exists. How we'll know: O01-to-O05 completion. Re-add the questions when the catalogue grows.

findings.title: F10. The coach funnel is closed, and when it opens it is about 20 taps plus 2 reviews before she can reach a trainee. Impact 4 (coach acquisition, which drives trainee acquisition), Effort L, Evidence
findings.where: feature_flags.dart:210-213. app_router.dart:994. youre_in_view.dart:106-115. K01-K06 in app_routes.dart:131-136. coach_being_checked_view.dart:5-16
findings.problem: At launch there is no coach acquisition at all, so the channel where each coach brings her trainees is unused. In code, a coach does the full trainee ID check, then K01-K05 forms, then a certificate review. Even then the marketplace is off, so there is no way to invite a trainee. findings.fix: Not for this hour. When coaching ships: show the coach button on C13 only when lastSignupRole needs a coach application. keep: Locale auto-detected from the phone before the first frame (main.dart:194-210), so an Arabic handset opens in Arabic.
OTP auto-submits on the 6th digit, with the SMS Retriever API or the iOS code suggestion and no SMS permission (code_view.dart:10-15).

Consent recorded before any camera opens, and a real decline path to a woman reviewer with no camera (consent_view.dart:16-27, app_router.dart:1031-1049). This is the legal core; keep it, only reorder around it.
A niqab path that never asks for a selfie (app_router.dart:1018-1021).
Every setup question has a preselected answer plus Skip and Close, and leaving setup is always safe (goal_view.dart:12-13, onboarding_state.dart:86-100).
O05 reads her own answers back, and 'Start day 1 now' lands her in R03 with Home underneath (app_router.dart:1335-1348).
A returning verified woman skips the check and setup (app_router.dart:952-971).
One-tap plate logging from Home (app_router.dart:1395-1399).
K06 gives a waiting coach real work instead of a dead end (coach_being_checked_view.dart:5-16).
The weekly, no-daily-streak model: build reminders on it rather than replacing it.
The local-first architecture: it is what makes F1 (value before verification) technically cheap.
verdict:
The app is carefully built, but the funnel is upside down. She pays everything up front: phone, OTP, national ID front and back, a liveness selfie, a server wait and a community pledge. Only then, about 20 screens and 18-19 taps in, does she see one thing made for her. A woman sent to human review gets nothing at all until someone calls. At launch every feature behind that gate is local-only and the community is off, so the gate costs a lot of activation and protects nothing shared yet. The constraint allows deferring the check until it is needed, so this is a fixable ordering choice. Nothing can be measured today (no analytics) and nothing brings her back on day 2 (no reminders). Coach acquisition is zero at launch.

IF WE ONLY FIX THREE THINGS:
1. F1, value before the ID check. Let a phone-verified woman use local-only Train, Eat and Cycle while her check runs or waits for review, and keep the gate on everything shared. This removes the single largest leak, including the indefinite zero-value review wait. It needs the owner's sign-off because it reverses decision G1.
2. F2 with F3, move her plan in front of the cost. Ask the setup questions before the phone number, so O05's 'Built from your four answers' is the reason to finish the check. Then replace the pledge for a switched-off community with 'Start my first workout' on C13. Both are mostly re-wiring of existing screens, so they are cheap.
3. F4, instrument the funnel. Every number in this audit is a guess until a privacy-safe 'reached step X' counter exists. Without it, we cannot tell whether fixes 1 and 2 worked or defend the verification cost.

FIX PLAN, ordered by impact then effort:
1. F7 (risk 5, S). Release smoke test plus a startup check that the functions are reachable. Worked when: a recorded end-to-end pass, and no C14 waits without a booking.
2. F4 (5, M). Anonymous step counters. Worked when: a daily C01-to-R03 funnel exists.
3. F1 (5, M). Gate shared features only. Worked when: more installs start a first workout within 24 hours, and C14 users still log sessions.
4. F2 (4, S-M). O01-O04 before C06. Worked when: the C06-to-C13 completion rate rises.
5. F5 (4, M). Local weekly reminders opted into at O05. Worked when: day-2 and day-7 return rates rise.
6. F3 (3, S). C13 CTA becomes 'Start my first workout', and the pledge waits for the community. Worked when: C13-to-R03 in the same session rises.
7. F6 (3, S). Wrong or expired OTP messages. Worked when: OTP exits fall.
8. F8 (2, S). Skip the one-card C08, and fold C02 into C01. Worked when: the C01-to-C06 rate rises.
9. F9 (2, S). Trim the setup questions to the ones that change something. Worked when: O01-O05 completion rises.

NOT WORTH FIXING NOW:
- F10, the coach funnel (L effort). The coach app is off and needs a backend and payments first; revisit at release 2.
- Merging C09 and C09b. The disclosure is legally load-bearing, so tighten the copy only.
- Fake C04 previews. F1 makes Look Around unnecessary.
- T08 and other route edge cases. No funnel impact.

OUT OF CODE, each with a cheap test:
(a) Will Egyptian women hand over a national ID to a new app before seeing any value? This is an assumption; nothing in the brief tells us. Test: show 20 target women a clickable prototype in each order (ID first versus value first), 10 per arm. If the ID-first arm completes about as well as the value-first arm, keep the current order and drop F1.
(b) Is women-only verification the reason they would install, or a cost they tolerate? Also an assumption. Test: ask 15 women to rank 'verified women-only' against 'quiet home workouts' against 'Egyptian food'. If verification ranks first for most of them, lead C01 and C03 with it and make the check feel like the entry ticket.
(c) Will coaches recruit through a portfolio, or do they need an invite link to clients they already have? Test: interview 5 Egyptian women coaches and ask them to send a fake invite link to 3 of their clients. If clients open the link, prioritise invite links over the marketplace.
(d) Does a weekly reminder bring her back without breaking the no-streak promise? Test: a WhatsApp reminder pilot with 10 beta users, weekly versus none. If the reminded group does not return more, drop F5's priority.

Note: the investor brief also asked for impact scores per Skeptic finding and respect for the Advocate's PROTECTS CORE alternatives, but neither was supplied. The IDs above are my own findings.

approach: I traced the real launch stack (main.dart _firstRunStack / frontDoor), the whole-app verification gate and every C, O, T, R, E, Y and K builder in lib/routing/app_router.dart. I extracted the navigation graph from the goTo() edges with a script and ran a breadth-first search for tap depth, using the shipped feature flags (accountRequired on, coach, community and marketplace off). I then read each signup and setup view to count taps, text inputs, waits and decisions, and pulled the exact EN/AR copy from the ARB files. The repo notes (COUNCIL_REPORT.md, DECISIONS_NEEDED.md, VERIFICATION_SPEC.md, AUDIT.md) do not exist in this worktree, so I could not check findings against them.
trainee_path:
Shipped flags: accountRequired on, coachApp, community, marketplace and assistant off. Taps are given as [n], waits as (wait).

1. C01 Welcome: "Get started" [1]. Headline: "A room full of women training like you".
2. C02 Language: preselected from the phone's language, "Continue" [1].
3. C03 What's inside: "Create my account" [1]. The alternative, "Look around first", opens C04, a static teaser.
4. C06 Phone: top bar says "Step 1 of 2". She types a 10-digit number (text input 1), then "Send me a code" [1]. (wait: SMS)
5. C07 Code: top bar says "Step 2 of 2". iOS autofill suggestion [1], or she types 6 digits (text input 2). It submits on the sixth digit. (wait: claim and status reads, up to 3 s each)
6. C08 Role: only "I'm here to train" is shown, preselected, then "Continue" [1]. A decision with only one option.
7. C09 "One check, then you are in": "Scan my ID" [1].
8. C09b "Before the camera opens" (consent): "I agree, start the camera" [1], plus the OS camera permission dialog [1].
9. C10 ID front: auto-capture [0], or "Take it myself" [1].
10. C10b ID back: auto [0 or 1]. (wait: startLiveness)
11. C11 Selfie: liveness challenge, then "Done" [1].
12. C12 Checking: (wait, "Usually seconds"). It moves on by itself when verified.
13. C13 "You're in": "Read the three rules" [1].
14. C16 Pledge: "I agree, let me in" [1].
15. O01 Goal, O02 Place and equipment, O03 Days and minutes, O04 Life stage: "Continue" ×4 [4], plus about 5 optional choice taps.
16. O05 Starting program: "Start day 1 now" [1]. The stack is cleared to [T01, R03].
17. R03 Workout day: "Start" [1], which opens R07, the first set. The workout has started.

That is 21 screens, 2 text inputs and about 10 decisions. Minimum is 18 taps, typical is about 25 with real setup answers and manual captures. The budget is 15, so it fails.

There is a hidden faster path: the X on O01 marks setup done with defaults, then T01 "Start day 1", then R03 Start = 15 taps. No user will find it.

Time, my estimate (no timing data in code): about 3 min 10 s of reading and tapping, not counting the SMS and C12 waits. That is at or over the 3-minute budget.

Branches:
- Niqab, or "I would rather not" on C09b: C15 woman reviewer, then C14 waiting. Nothing in the app opens while she waits, except the C04 teaser.
- Camera permission denied: C10 shows a disabled button and no explanation.
- C06 offline or provider error: the button stops spinning and nothing is said.
- Wrong OTP: the boxes clear silently.
- Daily limit or app cannot reach Own Hub: C12 shows a stop screen with "Close", which returns to the front door.
- Kill and relaunch: if signed in but not verified, the gate sends her to C09 or C14 (good). If killed between C13 and O04, she relaunches on [T01, O01], so the pledge is skipped and setup restarts at question 1 with her saved answers.

After onboarding, the bottom nav has three tabs: Home, Train, Eat. Day-one Home offers one big "Start day 1", a "Your first week" row and "Tell us one thing you eat". It has no cycle entry and no progress entry.

keep: The verification gate resumes properly. A signed-in but unverified woman who relaunches goes straight to C09, or to C14 if a reviewer is pending, never back to 'Get started' (app_router.dart gateDestination ~820-840, frontDoorFor :4654).
The app opens in the phone's language before the first frame (main.dart _firstRunLocale), so an Arabic phone never sees English first.
The OTP submits itself on the sixth digit, and iOS offers oneTimeCode autofill (code_view.dart:198, app_code_field.dart:134). The C07 step is 1 tap.
ID capture fires automatically when sharp, and 'Take it myself' is the fallback (id_capture_view.dart:96-99).
The niqab path and 'I would rather not' both lead to a woman reviewer. No failure state accuses her (C09 :58-64, C09b :166-172, C12 _onState).
Consent is written before any camera opens and is enforced at the route, not by hiding buttons (app_router.dart _opensALens guard ~385-390).
Every setup question is preselected and the X exits with a valid intake. 'Start day 1 now' clears the stack to [T01, R03] (onboarding_state.dart leaveSetupToHome).
Day-one Home has one dominant action ('Start day 1', 56 pt) and an honest empty state, and E09 lets her log a starter plate in one tap.

Dark features are never drawn as dead doors: the nav bar and Home rows check screenIsOn (app_nav_bar.dart:135, today_view.dart:620). Chevrons mirror correctly in RTL (app_chevron.dart). Tap targets have a 44 pt floor (app_chip_row.dart:70, avatar 44).
verdict: It does not meet the brief. The best route from install to first workout is 18 taps, about 25 in practice, over 21 screens and roughly 3 minutes. One promised first action, planning her diet, cannot be completed at all: no screen can put a dinner on a day. The most urgent defect is C12, which shows a working Continue button while the check is still running. A woman who taps it is told "You're in", answers the setup questions, and is then thrown back to "One check, then you are in". Remove that button and drive C12 only from the verification result. After that, about 8 to 13 taps can go without touching the women-only check: fold C02 into the welcome, skip the one-option role screen, merge C09 with the consent screen, move the pledge to the community, and reduce four setup questions to one 'Your week' screen asked before the ID step. That gets her to a running workout in about 10 taps. Missing capabilities to add next: a 1-tap way to plan the week's dinners and to start cycle tracking from day-one Home, and a coach invite link, without which a coach can never get a client.

auditor: Noura and Coach Dina, first-time users
persona: Noura and Coach Dina, first-time users
approach: I traced the shipped route graph from the code: main.dart first-run stack, FeatureFlags.shipped (accountRequired on, coachApp, community, payments and marketplace off), AppRouter._built and the verification gate. Then I walked each screen in Arabic using the app_ar.arb strings, extracted per view with a script that maps l10n keys to their EN and AR values. I role-played Noura (Arabic-first, low tech confidence, nervous about her ID) and Dina (a busy coach) screen by screen, counted taps, fields, waits and branches, and confirmed every quit moment against file:line. The repo notes named in the brief (COUNCIL_REPORT.md, DECISIONS_NEEDED.md, VERIFICATION_SPEC.md, AUDIT.md) are not in this worktree, so this audit rests on the code and the ARB files only.
trainee_path:
Shipped build, Arabic phone, happy path. Front door is C01 because accountRequired=true (feature_flags.dart:188, main.dart _frontDoor). Setup O01 is not stacked on a first launch because OnboardingState.isDue needs isVerified (onboarding_state.dart:79-82).
1. C01 Welcome: "غرفة مليئة بنساء يتدرّبن مثلك" plus one subline. Tap "لنبدأ" (tap 1).
2. C02 Language: picked from the phone. Tap "متابعة" (tap 2). This is a screen she did not need.
3. C03 What's inside: three promises. Tap "أنشئي حسابي" (tap 3). The other choice, "تصفّحي أولًا", goes to C04: two placeholder workouts, every row opens the join sheet, and the bottom bar does nothing.
4. C06 Phone: "الخطوة 1 من 2". Type the number (field 1). Tap "أرسلي إليّ رمزًا" (tap 4).
5. C07 Code: "الخطوة 2 من 2". Type 6 digits (field 2). It checks itself, and Android reads the SMS.
6. C08 Role: "أيّهما أنتِ؟" with only one card at launch. Tap "متابعة" (tap 5).
7. C09 Why we check. Tap "صوّري بطاقتي" (tap 6).
8. C09b Consent: five bullets that mention Google Cloud outside Egypt and a hash. Tap "أوافق وأبدأ التصوير" (tap 7), then the OS camera permission (tap 8).
9. C10 ID front: auto-capture, or "سألتقطها بنفسي" (0-1 taps).
10. C10b ID back: auto-capture (0-1).
11. C11 Selfie: a liveness challenge (blink, turn), then "تمّ" (tap 9).
12. C12 Checking: a wait of seconds.
13. C13 "أهلًا بك". Tap "اقرئي القواعد الثلاث" (tap 10).
14. C16 Pledge. Tap "أوافق، أدخليني" (tap 11).
15. O01 to O04: four questions, each with a preselected answer. Tap "متابعة" four times (taps 12-15).
16. O05 Starting program. Tap "ابدئي اليوم 1 الآن" (tap 16).
17. R03 Workout day "الساقان والأرداف". Tap "ابدئي، كل شيء جاهز" (tap 17).
18. R07 First set.
Total: about 21 screens, 17 taps, 2 text fields, 3 camera captures and 1 wait.
Branches:
- Niqab, decline or automatic failure: C15 "اطلبي تحقّقًا بالفيديو", then C14 "قيد المراجعة". The whole app stays locked, no wait time is given, and "ألقي نظرة على التطبيق أثناء الانتظار" leads to the placeholder C04.
- Offline at C06 or C07: no message at all (silent).
- Offline at C09b or C12: clear copy and a retry.
- If she taps "متابعة" while C12 is still checking, she reaches "أهلًا بك" without being verified. After setup the gate sends her back to C09.
After onboarding, Home (T06 day one) shows "تدريبك، أسبوعًا بعد أسبوع" and one big "ابدئي اليوم 1" button. Below it are "أسبوعك الأول" and "أخبرينا بشيء واحد تتناولينه". Noura knows to start a workout. She does not know where her cycle, progress or diet plan live: the bar has only Home, Train and Eat.
coach_path:
At launch: none. coachApp=false (feature_flags.dart:210), so C08 shows only "أنا هنا لأتدرّب" (app_router.dart:991-995, role_view.dart:120-145). Dina signs up and verifies as a trainee, then walks trainee setup. Nothing anywhere lets her become a coach. The C08 line "يمكنك تغيير هذا لاحقًا من ملفك" is false, because profile_view.dart has no role row.
As coded with the flag on:
- C01 to C07 as for Noura (4 taps, 2 fields).
- C08: tap "أنا أدرّب النساء", then "متابعة" (6).
- C09 to C11 ID and selfie (about 9-10).
- C12 wait.
- C13: the primary button is "اقرئي القواعد الثلاث". The coach option is a secondary text link, "أنا مدرِّبة، أنشئي ملفي" (11). If she follows the primary button, she goes to the pledge, then the trainee goal questions, then trainee Home.
- K01 "عرّفي المتدرِّبات بنفسك": photo, name, city, one line (4 fields), "متابعة" (12).
- K02 Certificates: in production the add rows do nothing, because onAddCertificate is null when not in test mode (app_router.dart:3005-3009). "متابعة" (13).
- K03: pick up to three specialties, then "متابعة" (about 15-16).
- K04: capacity, then "متابعة" (about 18).
- K05 "أين نرسل أموالك؟": Continue stays disabled while payments is off (coach_view_models.dart:150, coach_payout_view.dart:128). She has to take "احفظي وأغلقي" (about 19).
- K07 desk: "لا متدرِّبات بعد". K06 ("ابني أول خطة لي") is reachable only through K05, and K05 cannot be finished.
- There is no way to invite her own existing clients. She waits for marketplace enquiries, and marketplace is off.
Total to an empty desk: about 17 screens, about 19 taps, 6+ fields and the ID check. Her application is never submitted.
