findings.title: Continue on the Checking screen lets her skip verification and see 'You're in'
findings.problem: While the check is running, the footer shows an enabled 'متابعة' wired to goTo(C13). Noura taps it out of habit, the way she taps through WhatsApp prompts. She sees 'أهلًا بك' and 'حُذفت صورة بطاقتك', reads the rules, answers four questions, and is then thrown back to C09 'تحقّق واحد، ثم تدخلين' by the gate. She will think the app is broken or that she failed. The two steps 'قُرئت البطاقة' and 'طوبقت الصورة الذاتية مع البطاقة' are also hard-coded as done (const _Step done:true, :262-275), and the ring is fixed at 0.72 (:39), so the screen claims progress that has not happened.
findings.evidence: footer: [AppButton(l10n.continueLabel, onPressed: widget.onContinue)]; router: onContinue: () => goTo(context, 'C13')
findings.fix: Remove the Continue button from the running state, or disable it until the repository reports a result. Let the listener move her on. Drive the step ticks from real state. If the check stalls, show 'still checking… ask a woman reviewer' after N seconds.

findings.where: C08 role_view.dart:136-145 with feature_flags.dart:210; K02 app_router.dart:3005-3009; K05 coach_view_models.dart:150 and coach_payout_view.dart:128

findings.title: Phone and code screens fail silently

Low-confidence Noura cannot tell whether she typed it wrong, has no signal, or the app is broken. This is the first place she would close the app. The code comment says the translated strings already exist in i18n/msa/14-states.json but are not wired.

findings.title: Waiting for a reviewer locks the whole app, with no time estimate
findings.where: C14 being_checked_view.dart:244-245, 302, 348; C15 woman_reviewer_view.dart:135; gate app_router.dart:820-845
findings.problem: Women on the niqab path, women who decline the camera, and any failed automatic check are told 'ستتصل بكِ مراجِعة من Own Hub هاتفيًا' and 'يفتح التطبيق بمجرد انتهاء التحقق', but never when. 'ألقي نظرة على التطبيق أثناء الانتظار' leads to C04, which has two placeholder workouts, rows that all reopen the join sheet, and a bottom bar that does nothing (look_around_view.dart:139). Noura closes the app and forgets it. This is the biggest drop-off risk among women who cannot or will not use the camera.
findings.fix: Show an honest time window ('عادةً خلال 24 ساعة' with working hours). Use push and SMS opt-in for the call. While she waits, unlock the private, non-community parts that need no verification (workouts, meal logging, cycle on her own phone). Keep the gate on community and coaching. This is a reorder, not a removal: the women-only check still guards every shared space.

findings.title: Setup promises personalisation it does not deliver, including for pregnancy
findings.where: O04 life_stage_view.dart:177 and doc :21-26; O05 starting_program_view.dart:116-118, 168; R03 workout_day_view.dart:113-177
findings.problem: Noura answers four questions. O05 says 'مبنية على إجاباتك الأربع' but always shows 'أساسيات للمبتدئات · 8 أسابيع · هادئ · بدون أدوات', even when she picked 'صالة للنساء فقط' and dumbbells. If she ticks 'حامل', O04 says 'ولا يتغيّر شيء في تمارينكِ بسببها حتى الآن'. 'Start day 1 now' then opens 'الساقان والأرداف' with step-back lunges and 'تمرين الحشرة الميتة' (on the back). The name on O05 and the session on R03 also differ. This breaks trust at the exact moment she should get hooked, and it is a safety concern for pregnant users.
findings.fix: Until real programmes exist, ask only what changes something (days and minutes, which do set the weekly goal). Drop or defer the goal and place questions, or say plainly 'سنستخدم هذا قريبًا'. For pregnant and postpartum answers, route to a gentle, reviewed session or show a clear 'استشيري طبيبتك' gate before R03. Name the same programme on O05, Home and R03.

findings.title: Progress counters lie: 'Step 1 of 2' is followed by about 14 more screens
findings.where: C06 phone_number_view.dart:113 ('الخطوة 1 من 2'); C07 code_view.dart:152 ('الخطوة 2 من 2'); O01-O04 intake_step_scaffold.dart:76 ('of 4'); K-steps coach_setup_scaffold.dart:49
findings.problem: Noura finishes 'الخطوة 2 من 2' and believes she is done. Then come role, why we check, consent, two ID sides, a selfie, a wait, you're in, a pledge, and a new counter that restarts at '1 من 4'. Every restart feels like the app moving the goalposts, and that is where people give up.
findings.fix: Use one honest progress model for the whole path, for example three chapters ('رقمك · التحقق · خطتك') shown as a 3-dot header on every screen, with a time estimate ('نحو 3 دقائق') stated once on C03.

findings.title: Consent screen is accurate but frightening for a low-tech user
findings.problem: Noura reads two screens that both explain the check. C09 promises 'لا تُحفظ صور بطاقتكِ ولا صورتكِ الذاتية أبدًا. اضغطي لتعرفي بدقة ما الذي يُحفظ', but that line is plain Text and cannot be tapped (:98-101). C09b then says 'تُعالَج الصور لدى Google Cloud على خوادم خارج مصر' and 'بصمة مشفّرة أحادية الاتجاه'. 'Outside Egypt' after 'never stored' reads as a contradiction, and she does not know what a hash is. This is her most likely quit point after C06. C09 also says 'نحو 90 ثانية' while C04 says 'نحو دقيقتين'.
findings.fix: Keep the legal content but layer it. C09b gets one plain headline ('صورك تُحذف فور انتهاء الفحص، ولا يراها أي رجل'), three short bullets, and a 'التفاصيل' expander holding the processor, location and hash text. Merge C09 into C09b so it is one screen. Make the 'what is kept' line a real link. Use one time estimate everywhere.

findings.title: The pledge asks her to agree to community rules for a community that is switched off
findings.problem: Straight after 'أهلًا بك', Noura must agree to 'لا لقطات شاشة' and 'لا تعليق على جسد أي امرأة أخرى' under the threat 'من تخالف واحدة منها تفقد مكانها'. At launch there is no community to post in, so this is an extra screen with a punitive tone between her and her first workout.
findings.fix: Defer the pledge to the first time she opens Community (or behind the community flag), and keep the consent record written at that moment. At launch, go from C13 straight to O01 with a warm 'لنجهّز أسبوعكِ'.

findings.title: 'Look around first' is a dead end with a fake bottom bar and tabs that change nothing
findings.where: C04 look_around_view.dart:139 (AppNavBar with no onSelect), :156-185 (list ignores _tab)
findings.problem: A curious Noura taps 'تصفّحي أولًا'. The 'وصفات' tab still shows the same two workouts. Every workout opens 'أتحفظين هذا التمرين؟'. The bottom bar is drawn but does nothing. She learns nothing about what the app does and feels tricked.
findings.fix: Show one real playable sample workout (a 2-minute preview video) and 3 real Rahma recipes in the Recipes tab. Hide the bottom bar for guests. Keep one 'انضمّي · نحو دقيقتين' button.

findings.title: Cycle and progress are hidden; Home day one never mentions them
findings.where: Home today_view.dart:498-585 and :366-376 (cycle card only if showCycleCard); app_nav_bar.dart traineeTabs (Home, Train, Eat at launch); profile_view.dart:204
findings.problem: The app is pitched as train, eat, cycle and progress. After onboarding, Noura sees three tabs and no mention of her cycle. Cycle setup is avatar > Profile > My cycle > Set up. Progress is reached only by tapping the week block. She will not find either, and 'log her data' fails.
findings.fix: Add 'تتبّعي دورتكِ' as a day-one row on Home (one tap to Y01), next to the meal row. Optionally offer cycle as an optional O-step after life stage, with the health-data consent shown at that moment. Consider a Progress tab or a labelled 'تقدّمي' row.

findings.title: For a coach, 'You're in' pushes the trainee path first
findings.problem: Dina chose 'أنا أدرّب النساء', but C13 ignores lastSignupRole. The primary button is 'اقرئي القواعد الثلاث', which leads to the trainee goal question 'ما الذي تريدينه أكثر؟'. Her own path is a small text link. If she takes it, she skips the pledge entirely, so the pledge consent record is never taken for coaches.
findings.fix: Branch C13 on role: coaches get a primary 'أنشئي ملفكِ المهني' leading to K01, with the pledge shown inside the coach setup before publishing. Trainees keep the current flow.

findings.title: There is no way for a coach to invite her existing clients
findings.problem: Dina already has clients on WhatsApp. Her desk says 'لا متدرِّبات بعد · حين تطلب امرأة العمل معك تصل إلى هنا'. Her only source of trainees is the marketplace, which is off. Her first useful action, getting a trainee onto a plan, is impossible.
findings.fix: Add 'ادعي متدرِّبة' on K07: a share link or code, sent through WhatsApp, that walks the invitee through the same verification and links the two women. Also ship a 'Build my first plan' entry on K07 so it does not depend on K05.

findings.title: The role screen asks 'Which one are you?' with one option, and says something untrue
findings.problem: Noura sees 'أيّهما أنتِ؟' and a single card. The question makes no sense, and it is a wasted tap. 'يمكنك تغيير هذا لاحقًا من ملفك' is false, because Profile has no role switch.
findings.fix: Skip C08 entirely while coachApp is off and set the trainee role silently. When it is on, make the copy match whatever role-change path actually exists.

findings.title: Arabic button voice switches between 'I' and 'you'
findings.where: phone_number_view.dart:115 'أرسلي إليّ رمزًا'; whats_inside_view.dart:42 'أنشئي حسابي'; pledge_view.dart:40 'أوافق، أدخليني'; youre_in_view.dart:110 'أنا مدرِّبة، أنشئي ملفي'; consent_view.dart:162 'أوافق وأبدأ التصوير'
findings.problem: Some buttons speak as her ('أوافق وأبدأ'). Others are feminine imperatives addressed to her but meaning the app's action ('أرسلي إليّ رمزًا' reads as 'you (f.) send me a code'). Noura has to work out who is doing what on the very screens where she is already nervous.
findings.fix: Pick one convention: the app speaks to her in feminine imperative for her actions ('أنشئي حسابكِ', 'أرسلي الرمز'), and first person only for consent ('أوافق'). Fix the four strings in app_ar.arb.

findings.title: Exercise names and terms on the first workout are confusing in Arabic
findings.where: R03 workout_day_view.dart:155 'تمرين الحشرة الميتة'; coach_today_view.dart:261 'العميلات' vs 'المتدرِّبات' everywhere else; K06 'وسنرسل إليك رسالة' vs C14 'لا نرسل رسائل نصية بشأن ذلك'
findings.problem: A literal 'dead insect exercise' on her first workout reads as a joke. The coach app calls clients by two different words. The coach screen promises an SMS while the trainee screen says no SMS is sent.
findings.fix: Use a plain descriptive name ('تمرين الظهر على الأرض مع مدّ الذراع والساق') with the English in small print. Use 'المتدرِّبات' consistently. Align the SMS promises.

findings.title: The welcome screen does not say what the app does or how long joining takes
findings.problem: 'غرفة مليئة بنساء يتدرّبن مثلك' is a mood, not a promise. Noura does not know this is a workout, food and cycle app until C03, two taps in. C02 adds a tap even though the app already opened in her phone's language.
findings.fix: Lead with a concrete line ('تمارين منزلية هادئة، وأكل مصري، وتتبّع دورتكِ، للنساء فقط'). Add a small language toggle on C01 instead of a full C02 screen. Show '≈3 دقائق للانضمام' under 'لنبدأ'.

keep: The first launch opens in the phone's language (main.dart _firstRunLocale), so Noura sees Arabic from the first frame.
C03 promises are concrete and Egyptian: 'كشري وفول وملوخية بالمقادير التي تقدّمينها فعلًا. بلا جرامات'.
Auto-capture of the ID ('تُلتقط الصورة تلقائيًا حين تصبح واضحة'), auto-checking OTP with Android SMS read, and the step counter shown during the liveness challenge.
Dignified alternatives: the niqab path 'أرتدي النقاب، تحقّقوا مني بطريقة أخرى' and 'أفضّل ألا أفعل', both leading to a woman reviewer with no camera.
C12, C09b and C14 failure copy is honest and calm ('لم يُتخذ أي قرار ولستِ في أي قائمة انتظار').
Every setup question is preselected and skippable, the X exits setup cleanly, and the days answer really sets the weekly goal (onboarding_state.dart _applyWeeklyTarget).
O05 'ابدئي اليوم 1 الآن' drops straight into a workout with the sign-up stack cleared, and Home day one has one big obvious button.
Home day one's empty state explains itself ('سيظهر هنا تمرين اليوم...') and 'أسبوعك الأول' is a gentle no-expiry checklist.
One-tap starter meals on Eat day one, which make a first log possible in two taps.
Dark features are hidden rather than shown as dead doors (Community rows, the assistant icon and the coach CTA all check screenIsOn).
verdict:
Noura gets in only if she survives 11 screens of account and identity work before the app has shown her anything she can use. She would probably finish if every step works, because the copy is kind, the ID camera captures by itself, and Home day one has one obvious 'ابدئي اليوم 1' button. But the path has sharp edges right where she is most nervous. The phone and code screens fail with no message. Two 'Step x of 2' labels lie about how much is left. The consent screen talks about 'خوادم خارج مصر' and a hash right after promising nothing is stored. A live Continue button on the Checking screen can show her 'You're in' before she is verified, then throw her back to the check. Women on the niqab path or whose automatic check fails wait in a fully locked app with no time estimate. After onboarding, setup claims to be 'built from your answers' but gives every woman the same programme, even when she said she is pregnant or trains at a gym. Diet planning cannot be reached on day one, and cycle tracking is buried in Profile, so only one of the three goals (start a workout) is fast: about 17 taps. Coach Dina cannot sign up at all at launch. Even with the flag on, her certificate and payout steps cannot be completed in production, there is no way to invite her own clients, and C13 pushes her into the trainee pledge and trainee questions. Highest-leverage fixes:
1. Kill the C12 Continue button.
2. Wire the OTP error strings.
3. Use one honest three-chapter progress bar.
4. Layer the consent screen and merge C09 into C09b.
5. Defer the pledge until Community exists.
6. Unlock private features while a reviewer is pending.
7. Add diet-plan and cycle entry points to day one.
8. Make setup either truly personal or shorter.
9. For coaches, capture a waitlist now, then fix K02 and K05 and add invites before the coach app turns on.
